blind_benchmark.registered: 2026-10-14, committed before these companies' data was loaded into the application or any analysis was run
blind_benchmark.policy: Blind real-company cases: no risk rule, threshold or extraction rule may be changed in response to their results. They are REPORTED, not release-gating: three companies measure predictive skill, they do not validate it, and gating on them would invite fitting the rules to the answers. The only gating property is that each analysis completes. Outcome notes describe what happened AFTER the cut-off and are never shown to the application.

expectation_bands.elevated: risk_score >= 55 (recommendation 'Renegotiate price and terms' or stricter)
